headline: Approved May 28, 2026 meeting minutes and elected new Chair and Vice Chair, 10-0 each.
summary: The Council approved the May 28, 2026 meeting minutes as amended and elected Zach Servideo as Chair and Chris Wrenn as Vice Chair, both by a vote of 10-0. The group then discussed the Economic Development Action Plan, including how to present it to the public, prioritize 85 identified actions, and measure progress toward six economic development goals. No further decisions were made on these discussion items.
decisions: Approved the May 28, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, 10-0.
Elected Zach Servideo as Chair and Chris Wrenn as Vice Chair, 10-0.
